writerLeaseCorrection.rootCause: A cancelled or released Web Locks request was not fully settled before reacquisition; StrictMode could leave a single tab busy with zero held locks. Busy UI had no retry.
writerLeaseCorrection.mechanism: Serialize own request lifetimes, coalesce pending acquisition, reject stale snapshots and unreadable storage; explicit retry and voluntary read-only release
